questions.q: What does Colossians say was created through Christ?
questions.evidence: For by him all things were created, in the heavens and on the earth, things visible and things invisible, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers

questions.q: To what was the record of debts against us nailed?
questions.evidence: and he has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross

questions.q: Where does Paul tell believers to set their minds?
questions.evidence: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth

questions.q: Whom does Paul call the beloved physician?
questions.evidence: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas greet you
